sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Key to the City is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "How's it going, brother? I heard the city's stirring up, collecting souvenirs, reminiscing over old times. And I just got a lead on something like this. They keep these things in museums. In the old days, each city had its own key, which the governor received at the time of establishment. I even saw one on a tour when I was a kid! They don't do that anymore, but Tarkov does have its own key, apparently! When the city was laid out, they made one for historical reference. And I know where to find it! If you bring it back, we'll make a fortune."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the souvenir key to the city on Streets of Tarkov
- Hand over the found item

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +55,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.02
- 145,000 Roubles
  - 152,250 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
  - 166,750 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
- 3× Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
"You got it? Nice! What do those numbers mean? Only the bright minds who know about Tarkov's history will understand that, probably."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Tarkov City souvenir key | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you have to find the Tarkov City souvenir key in the museum on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout the building.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The engraved date (5. August 2016) on the quest item's handle refers to the start of the Closed Alpha of the game.
